sources.title: GitHub - sanjayrahul77/MedVision
sources.snippet: MedVision AI is an end-to-end deep learning framework and screening application designed for binary pneumonia classification from chest X-rays. Built with EfficientNet-B0, class-balanced training, Grad-CAM visual interpretability, FastAPI backend microservice, and a Streamlit frontend interface, it implements a modular 7-layer ML pipeline optimized for CPU environments.
